_field_status.source_llm_known_ms_sum_null: no retained call supplies source_llm_ms; source duration uncollected

method.interpretation: seed intervals describe paired runner and attempt-selection variation within this fixed task pool and replay-time construction; heavily reused tasks and repositories constrain cross-task extrapolation
method.jaccard: size(task intersection)/size(task union), separately by N and source for all ten seed pairs
method.modeled_wait_scope: nonterminal tool_wait_ms with timing_source=modeled_fixed_wait; final retained calls excluded because terminal waits are removed
method.replay_token_scope: retained scaled numeric prompt/output tokens; source token totals likewise cover retained calls
method.replication_unit: one complete five-policy N x seed group; shared inputs across policies count once for coverage, overlaps, token shares and task occurrence
method.reproduction: from repository root, write method.reproduction_python to a temporary .py file; run CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" PYTHONPATH=. taskset -c 0-1 python3 <file>; verify audit_payload_sha256 and each source_file_sha256
method.request_denominator: sum of each selected trajectory.kept_turns; five-policy denominator multiplies this by five
method.selection: actual source-stratified sampler and deterministic runner workspace shuffle; one attempt per task within each N x seed
method.source_llm_timing_scope: source_llm_ms observed subset only; missing source timing counts retained; no runtime latency or performance outcomes consumed
